name: High School Farm Team
what_you_do: Teens volunteer on a farm that fights hunger. They get beds ready, plant seedlings, pick crops and pull weeds. They also learn how food gets to people. Service hours can be signed off if you ask.
who_can_apply: High school age teens, 14 to 18. Must attend at least 6 of the 9 sessions in a cohort.
duration: Two 3-week cohorts, 3 sessions a week (2026: June 24 to July 11, and July 22 to Aug 8)
deadline_text: 2026 cohort A ran June 24 to July 11 and cohort B was waitlist only. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up through Gaining Ground. Questions go to team leader Maddie at maddie@gainingground.org.
notes: Sessions run Wednesdays and Saturdays 8:45 am to 12 pm and Fridays 1 to 3:15 pm. Pay is not explicitly stated on the page.
